entries.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup / photorealistic-natural.
Asset: one portrait 3:4 cover image for an existing seven-project circular portfolio gallery.
Art direction for the entire series: premium REALISTIC TECHNOLOGY EDITORIAL PHOTOGRAPHY, believable physical equipment and photographic environments. Lifesize scale, realistic lenses, refined material detail, accurate perspective, subtle filmic contrast. Charcoal graphite and desaturated deep olive background (#20271e / #30382b), soft off-white screen detail, small restrained amber-gold highlights and a very small amount of muted teal technical data. No saturated blue or purple cyberpunk. Background dark but midtone subject readable at small card size; clean silhouette, focal subject occupies about 65% of image. Soft controlled studio or documentary lighting, believable reflections, crisp focal detail, quiet dark edge falloff. No title, no logos, no watermark, no large lettering. Software screens may have realistic fine UI graphics, avoid large generated text.
Strict visual constraints: NO cartoon, NO clay, NO cute toy, NO stylized illustration, NO low-poly, NO miniature or diorama, NO wooden craft scene, NO book-and-magnifying-glass ornaments, NO fantasy robot mascot, NO excessive neon or sci-fi hologram clutter. Must look like a high-end real technology photograph, not a rendered cartoon. Full bleed portrait image, no frame, no typography outside screen.
Project-specific subject: AI ZERO-CODE APP BUILDER: a real premium graphite computer monitor and slim keyboard in a contemporary software lab. On the monitor a convincing dark software interface: a narrow natural-language conversation pane next to a large freshly generated web application preview, with tiny syntax fragments and neatly arranged real UI components. One coherent physical screen, fine brushed aluminum, crisp pixels and restrained amber status LEDs. A close 3/4 professional product photograph; the screen and desk occupy the middle and lower portion, monitor tall enough to read as the hero. Convey an idea becoming a usable application through a thin, elegant amber visual path between the conversation and preview. No invented product branding.

entries.revisionPrompt: Edit this energy-storage load analysis project cover. Remove the ENTIRE human person from the image, including head, hair, glasses, torso, clothing, arms and hands. No people, no body parts, no human silhouettes or human reflections anywhere. Naturally fill the cleared left foreground with an unoccupied graphite industrial workbench and the existing laboratory background. Keep the battery cabinets, laptop, its 96-sample load analysis dashboard, highlighted amber interval, realistic metallic materials and graphite/olive/amber editorial photography style. Preserve portrait 3:4 composition and the laptop screen's software concept. Let the laptop and full-height battery cabinets be the clear subjects of this unoccupied energy testing lab. Do not introduce any cartoon, mascot, clay object, toy, miniature or new text outside the screen. Recompose the laptop slightly toward the center if needed to balance the newly clear foreground; do not crop the laptop or obstruct its screen. This is a realistic technology photograph for a portfolio cover, no person should remain.
